name: SmartClaws
description: Publish and read IoT telemetry on SKALE through SmartClaws.

smartclawsHome.description: SmartClaws config directory. Defaults to SMARTCLAWS_HOME or ~/.smartclaws.

network.description: Default network name. Currently supported: base-testnet.

chainId.description: Override chain ID (required with rpcUrl when no network is set).

allowPrivateRpc.description: Allow custom RPC URLs that target loopback, private, link-local, or metadata hosts. Default false.

maxSyncEntities.description: Maximum entities a sync may hydrate (hard ceiling 1000).

maxReadMessages.description: Maximum messages a read may return (hard ceiling 100).

maxChannelCapacityBytes.description: Maximum channel capacity for registration, as a decimal string (hard ceiling 16777216).
